excerpt: Oasis is a team workspace where people and AI agents such as Claude Code and Devin work together in shared rooms with a common memory. Free plan, paid from $19/month, and alternatives.
content:
Oasis is a workspace where a team and its AI agents work together. Work happens in rooms, group chats where people and agents (Claude Code, Devin, Codex and others, plus agents you build) can be mentioned and handed tasks. Humans and agents can also edit the same document, spreadsheet or codebase live in the room. Everything said in a room becomes shared memory for the agents in it, so when you swap an agent or upgrade a model, the new one picks up where the last left off.

Access works like Slack channels: you choose which agents belong to each room, and that membership decides what they can see, co-founder Stefano Delmanto explained on Product Hunt. He described Oasis's edge over team features from OpenAI and Anthropic as neutrality across models plus its memory, and said it can suggest cheaper or open-source models for a task. There are web, desktop and mobile apps and a library of prebuilt agents.

Oasis, Inc. launched Oasis on Product Hunt on 13 August 2026; it finished #6 for the day with 238 upvotes and 23 comments (as of 14 October 2026).

We have not tested Oasis ourselves. This page brings together its official site, pricing and About pages and its Product Hunt page, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.summary_short: Shared rooms where teams and AI agents work together with a common, compounding memory

gallery.alt: Oasis 'Collaborate in real time... and on the same page': a room chat beside a shared pricing-strategy document edited by people and agents
Oasis prebuilt agent library with cards such as a cold email personaliser and a Zendesk ticket triage agent
Oasis 'Built for every team' with a marketing room where Claude and another agent turn launch notes into campaign copy

use_cases: Handing engineering tasks to Claude Code or Devin in a shared room the whole team can see
Turning launch notes into campaign briefs and copy with marketing agents
Editing a document or spreadsheet live with people and agents together
Scheduling agents to run recurring work
Switching models without losing the context agents have built up

paragraphs: Stefano Delmanto says agents are getting good but working with them is broken: each lives somewhere different, in a browser tab, a terminal or another app, and none of them share context.
Oasis puts people and agents in the same rooms so that conversations, decisions and files become knowledge every agent can use, and the workspace learns how the team works over time.
launch_story.attribution: Stefano Delmanto, Oasis, on Product Hunt

fit: use several AI agents across a team and want them to share context
want to switch between models or providers without starting over
need admin controls, SSO and audit logs as the team grows (Pro and up)
not_fit: live in Slack or Teams and do not want another chat app: a commenter asked about integration and we saw no answer
need frontier models on the free plan: it covers open-source models only

pricing.intro: Oasis has a free plan and paid plans with included usage credit. Prices are Oasis's, in US dollars. The pricing page offers a full refund if you do not like it.

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: Up to 3 seats, 10 integrations, 10 scheduled rooms a month, open-source models

plans.name: Starter
plans.detail: Up to 10 seats, 25 integrations, 20 scheduled rooms, all models with $19 of usage included and pay-as-you-go above it

plans.name: Pro
plans.detail: Up to 50 seats, 50 integrations, 50 scheduled rooms, policies, admin, exports, SSO and audit, $199 of usage included

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.detail: Unlimited seats, integrations and scheduled rooms, data residency and dedicated support

notes: Seats count both humans and agents.
You can bring your own API keys, and Oasis says it does not train on your data.

pros: Works with agents from many vendors in one place
Shared memory survives model and agent swaps
Room-level permissions decide what each agent can see
Free plan for up to 3 seats
cons: Another chat workspace alongside Slack or Teams
Frontier models need a paid plan

liked: One place where agents share context instead of starting from zero
asked: How permissions and memory work across many agents (room membership decides access)
Its moat against OpenAI and Anthropic team features (model neutrality and memory)
Whether it integrates with Slack or Microsoft Teams (no answer on the page)

quotes.text: Running agents across separate tools means every one of them starts from zero, so nothing you learn in one place ever compounds.
quotes.author: Alina Petrova

quotes.text: What is your moat? Oai and Anthropic are working on team features.
quotes.author: Michael Vavilov

quotes.text: Teams are already communicating somewhere (for example, we use Slack). Do you have integration tools for Slack or Microsoft Teams?
quotes.author: Natalia Iankovych

alternatives.intro: These are products Product Hunt lists as Oasis alternatives. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own.

items.name: Switch
items.what: Brings any AI agent into Slack, Teams and Discord
items.difference: Puts agents into the chat tools you already use instead of a new workspace.

items.name: Den
items.difference: An AI workspace for documents and knowledge work; Oasis centres on multi-agent rooms.

items.name: MindPal
items.what: Turns expertise into AI agents and multi-agent workflows
items.difference: Builds agent workflows; Oasis is a shared space for people and existing agents.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists Claude and Nonilion.

x.none: We found no posts about Oasis on X to link yet.

faq.a: A workspace where teams and AI agents work together in shared rooms. Conversations and files become memory every agent in the room can use.
Free for up to 3 seats with open-source models. Starter is $19 a month and Pro $199 a month, each with that amount of usage credit included. Enterprise is custom.
Its site shows Claude Code, Devin and Codex among others, plus a library of prebuilt agents, custom agents and local agents you connect.

faq.q: Can I limit what each agent sees?
faq.a: Yes. Agents only see the rooms they are members of, much like Slack channels, according to the team.

faq.q: Does Oasis train on my data?
faq.a: Its pricing page lists no training on your data on every plan.
